chunks.title: soybean_Aalu_ki_sabji_Dhaba_style
chunks.text: Hello everyone, Assalamualaikum, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Asma Today I am going to tell you how to make Soyabean Potato curry Soak the Soyabean for 15-20 minutes and drain the water In a pan add salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and oil Add butter and saute for 5 minutes In the same pan fry the potatoes Cover the pan and let it fry for 5 minutes Add oil and saute for 5 minutes Add chopped onions and saute for 2 minutes Add green chillies and saute for 2 minutes Add dry spices and saute for 2 minutes Add tomato puree and saute for 2 minutes Add masala and mix well Add yogurt and mix well Add hot water and mix well Cover the pan and let it cook for 10 minutes After 15 minutes add fresh coriander leaves Add soyabean and mix well
